branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A blue-mould cheese from Bergader Privatkäserei in Waging am See, developed by Basil Weixler in the 1920s as a Roquefort-like cheese made from cow's milk. Produced since 1927.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
